name: chat-handoff
description: Shows how full the chat is, warns when it gets long, and writes a handoff note to paste into a new chat (/handoff).

warnAtPercent.title: Warn when the chat is this full (%)
warnAtPercent.description: How much of the model's context window the chat may fill before you are told. The warning repeats every 10 points after that.

whenReached.title: At the warning point
whenReached.description: warn: tell you and offer the handoff. write: tell you and write the handoff straight away.

saveFolder.title: Folder for saved handoffs
saveFolder.description: Each handoff is shown in the chat and also saved here, inside the working directory. Leave empty to keep it in the chat only.

alwaysInclude.title: Always include
alwaysInclude.description: Your own list of things every handoff must cover, on top of the standard sections. Separate items with commas.
